tagline: Declared formulas checked. Choose what fits your training.
description: We review the declared formula against the applicable ingredient charter. Quantities, forms, product evidence and warnings remain separate facts; prices are compared using the declared category unit.

copy.unit_basis: Per serving. The types on this page do not share one comparison unit, so each product names its own.
copy.screening_note: Published references have a readable, complete ingredient declaration checked against the applicable ingredient restrictions in charter 0.15.0. This first filter does not certify nutritional quality, efficacy or laboratory testing.
copy.audience_note: This selection is for adults and does not determine individual medical suitability.
copy.guide_heading: How do you like your performance?
copy.empty_body: We reviewed 1212 performance products reaching Kuwait and published none. Publication requires a completed ingredient check and an available Kuwait offer. Unresolved declarations and unavailable offers remain in the audit.

milk_allergy_empty.title: Nothing here is free of milk.
milk_allergy_empty.body: Every product published in this category declares milk, or has no dairy-free declaration we could read. We will not answer a declared milk allergy from silence.

director_selection.note: Editorial choices among ingredient-admitted references, recorded in the database.

types.name: Other creatine forms
types.purpose: Ingredient-first selection; forms and quantities remain distinct.

types.name: Creatine Monohydrate
types.purpose: The most studied performance supplement in existence. Also the easiest to overpay for.

types.name: Pre-Workout
types.purpose: Stimulant and pump formulas. The category with the highest rejection rate we have.

types.name: EAA & BCAA
types.purpose: Free-form amino acids for training on an empty stomach.

types.name: Beta-Alanine
types.purpose: Buffers the burn in efforts lasting one to four minutes.

types.name: Citrulline & Nitric Oxide
types.purpose: Blood-flow support taken before training, without the stimulants.
